NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

ITEM F - 4
5.
Development Code Amendment 252 – Housing Element Program Implementations The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider making a recommendation to the City Council regarding proposed amendments to Chapters 88.21, 88.22, 88.24, 88.26, 88.36, and 88.42 of the City of Azusa Development Code. The proposed changes are the first round of implementation of programs included in the City’s Adopted Housing Element. Amendments will included, but are not limited to, the following: allow stacked flats as a type of housing in any zone or district where townhomes are permitted, add senior apartments as a permitted use in the NG3- Medium Density Residential zoning district, remove Minor Use Permit requirement for senior citizen apartments in all zones where it is currently permitted with a MUP, and allow as a permitted use, and remove covered parking as a requirement for affordable units.
